name: Zhong Kui Supported by Ghosts
material: hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: In popular belief, Zhong Kui is a powerful guard against evil spirits, particularly on New Year’s Day and at the Double-Fifth Festival, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, when his image is displayed in households to prevent diseases and other misfortunes.
